# `passportsim clock`

Show or take the clock lease, pace it, or step instructions.

| MCP tool | Scenario step | macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passport_clock` | none | yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim clock <op> [--force] [--idle-skip] [--insns <INSNS>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--mode <MODE>] [--owner <OWNER>] [--speed <SPEED>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `force` | `--force` | `boolean` | no | Take the lease over (false). |
| `idle_skip` | `--idle-skip` | `boolean` | no | Skip idle time. |
| `insns` | `--insns <INSNS>` | `integer` | no | `step` instructions. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `mode` | `--mode <MODE>` | `"deterministic"` \| `"realtime"` | no | Pacing mode. |
| `op` | `<op>` | `"status"` \| `"pause"` \| `"resume"` \| `"set_speed"` \| `"set_mode"` \| `"take"` \| `"release"` \| `"step"` | yes | What to do. |
| `owner` | `--owner <OWNER>` | `"agent"` \| `"ui"` \| `"endpoint"` \| `"scenario"` | no | Lease holder (agent). |
| `speed` | `--speed <SPEED>` | `union` | no | Pacing factor, or `max`. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

## Errors

`E_USAGE` (1), `E_STATE` (2), `E_LEASE` (6), `E_GUEST_PANIC` (7), `E_DEADLOCK` (8), `E_STUCK` (9), `E_TRIPWIRE` (10), `E_UNMODELED` (11), `E_INTERNAL` (17), `E_HLE` (18). What each means: [errors.md](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Show the clock and who holds its lease

```sh
passportsim clock --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "op": "status"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "op": "status"
}
'@ | passportsim clock --json -
```

### Take the lease before driving the instance

```sh
passportsim clock --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "op": "take",
  "owner": "agent"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "op": "take",
  "owner": "agent"
}
'@ | passportsim clock --json -
```

### Step a thousand instructions

```sh
passportsim clock --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "insns": 1000,
  "op": "step"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "insns": 1000,
  "op": "step"
}
'@ | passportsim clock --json -
```
